title: Wave speed calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the wave speed using the wavelength and period of wave A.

title: Time for B to M
description: Essential: Correctly determines the time for wave B to first reach point M, resulting in 0.5 s.

title: Period of wave B
description: Important: Correctly determines the period of wave B from its wavelength and the wave speed.

title: Superposition condition
description: Important: Recognizes that maximum displacement occurs when crests from both waves arrive at M simultaneously.

title: Times for maximum displacement
description: Essential: Correctly lists the times (0.8 s, 1.6 s, 2.4 s) within the interval when M's displacement is maximum.

title: Wavelength extraction
description: Important: Correctly reads the wavelengths of waves A and B from the provided diagram.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns wave propagation direction, leading to wrong travel distance or phase.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (m, s, m/s) throughout the calculation.
